name: kestrel-support-v1
description: Fictional customer: Kestrel Home Goods. Golden set for the customer-support assistant covering policy answers, structured extraction, safety behaviour, and latency.

test_cases.input: How long do I have to return an item?
test_cases.expected_output: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund.

test_cases.input: My lamp arrived broken. What should I do?
test_cases.expected_output: Sorry it arrived damaged. Upload a photo on the Orders page within 14 days and we will ship a free replacement or issue a full refund.
Yes, we ship to Canada. International orders usually arrive in 7 to 12 business days.

test_cases.input: What does the furniture warranty cover?
test_cases.expected_output: Furniture has a 2 year warranty that covers manufacturing defects but not normal wear or accidental damage.
Phone support is open Monday to Friday, 8 am to 6 pm Pacific time.
